episodes.synopsis: Jyouji Ema becomes curious about his strange classmate, Miyoshi Hayashi, who keeps asking if he is adorable.
episodes.title: Someone Adorable

episodes.title: Would You Be My Friend? / The Artist

episodes.synopsis: Every day, Shoutarou Yamada must listen for one thing at school. A voice yelling "Run, Yamada!" by a bully.
episodes.title: Run, Yamada!

episodes.synopsis: Yuuichi dreads the new year, when the most ominous student, Akira Nikaidou, is assigned a seat behind him.
episodes.title: Nikaidou Behind Me

episodes.title: Nikaidou Behind Me: Terrifying School Trip Ver.
